instruction: Navigate to the browser's site settings page where you can control permissions for websites such as camera, microphone, and location access.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's site settings/content settings page (chrome://settings/content). Uses existing evaluator functions - is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter. No new functions needed. Similar difficulty to original task (simple navigation).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active Chrome tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab_approximate compares URLs while ignoring query parameters, which is appropriate for settings pages
Expected value is semantically correct: chrome://settings/content is the correct Chrome URL for site permissions (camera, microphone, location access)
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies navigation to the exact page specified in the instruction
goto_prefix is correctly set to empty string for chrome:// URLs (no https:// prefix needed)
No postconfig needed: URL verification works without keeping the page open
